edits.new: Before concluding full coverage, explicitly check every applicable parent restriction absent from the child's wording, including identity, role, purpose, intended use, consumer and state. Where the child's scope permits, test a case that satisfies all child requirements while lacking that parent restriction. It refutes coverage only if it escapes every parent alternative and permitted information connection. Use the full-coverage rule for a positive conclusion.
edits.old: Before concluding full coverage, explicitly check applicable parent identity and consumer restrictions absent from the child's wording. Where the child's scope permits, test an entity outside the required class in the constrained role while preserving all child requirements. Otherwise identify the child requirement or necessary implication excluding that case.
